audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose framed Karma as an engage threat ('his engage range', 'every assassin and fighter in the pool') with no reference to her actual 675-range tether.
audit.why: Karma has no dash and no gap-closer. The only thing that punishes Hwei is Focused Resolve (W, 675 range, flat 12s) landing its root, and Mantra converting that tether into a heal. Difficulty is a spacing problem, not an all-in problem.
audit.corrected: Even lane at 5.5/10 with a 52.7% Hwei win rate over 4,049 games. Hwei out-ranges Inner Flame (950) with QQ; the danger band is inside 675.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers: content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei and matched the packet levelChart, while every phases[N].side read 'Skill'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart and the content whys both describe a Hwei-favoured lane, and the 52.7% win rate supports it. The full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side and phases[4..6].side moved to Hwei to match win[N]; phases[3] stays Skill (Mantra Focused Resolve is the genuine coin-flip).

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability names throughout the content layer: 'Severalty (Q) wall', 'Devastating Fire Painting (E) stun', 'Molten Fissure (R)', and Karma's 'Renewal (W)' / 'Mantra Tranquility'.
audit.why: Riot's kit data gives Hwei QQ Devastating Fire, QE Molten Fissure, EQ Grim Visage (fear), R Spiraling Despair (1300 range). Karma's W is Focused Resolve; her heal is the Mantra bonus on that same W, and Mantra E applies Inspire shields. Hwei has no stun.
audit.corrected: Real names used; the decisive interaction stated: Focused Resolve only roots if the tether survives its duration, so leaving 675 range fizzles it, and Mantra W heals her through chip damage — Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank, Inner Flame 9/8/7/6/5, Mantra 40/38/36/34 and reduced by her damaging spells (passive).
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into the field.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Karma sustaining through chip via Mantra Focused Resolve.
audit.why: brief.missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this matchup.
